eps.d: After a serious argument with BraveStarr about the use of Sara Jane, Thirty/Thirty feels as though he does not fit in with BraveStarr anymore and decides to return to his past. It is not long before the two former friends are facing one another in battle.

BraveStarr is horrified when he learns that Jingles Morgan, a former Commander at the Marshall's Academy and a man who was once BraveStarr's hero, is a wanted outlaw. When he appears on New Texas, BraveStarr must fight his own feelings and arrest Jingles, a man wanted for murder.

The biggest kerium freighter in the galaxy arrives on New Texas, bringing with it an ambassador who is overseeing its arrival. The ambassador is unaware of the menace of Tex Hex and plans to have BraveStarr removed from New Texas.

BraveStarr, Thirty/Thirty and Fuzz visit the Prairie People kingdom to look at a huge new batch of Kerium that has been mined. Unfortunately, Skuzz sets off the self-destruct mechanism on the protective force dome, forcing Skuzz and Fuzz to cooperate!

eps.t: A Day in the Life of a New Texas Judge
eps.d: J.B.'s job is on the line when an Inspector from the Galactic Council arrives to observe how well she is doing as judge.

While BraveStarr is busy helping a young man named Altran rescue his people from Sandstorm, Thirty/Thirty wonders where his partner is, and so determinedly sets off to the Hexagon, prompting Tex Hex to desperately search for BraveStarr!

Lucas Conway's reluctance to use his gun when faced by villains seems like cowardice in the eyes of his son Mark. When Mark is captured by the villain Two Face, Lucas and BraveStarr must storm his fortress for a rescue, and Lucas must pick up his gun one more time in an effort to save his son.

Thirty/Thirty experiences being a father first hand when he is selected to temporarily look after a young Prairie Person named Wimble. However a vengeful Dingo named Howler decides to sabotage the school bus and attack the school kids.

A huge deposit of kerium is unearthed near Starr Peak by Billy Bob and Diamond Back. When Tex Hex hears about them registering a claim for the land, he decides to claim the land and evict Shaman from his sacred home!

Some of the human prospectors become jealous of the Prairie People, who have much better luck finding kerium. Tex Hex takes advantage of the situation, trying to instigate a war between the settlers and the Prairie folk.
